source: GTA IV 2026.10.10.9 stable release inventory; automated build and package checks are separate from live-game acceptance.

features.description: Explore GTA IV combat, independent ESP profiles, FOV styling, weapon loadouts, vehicle controls, spawners, teleport tools and interface settings.

website.notice: Released for exact Windows x86 GTA IV 1.0.7.0, 1.0.8.0 and Complete Edition 1.2.0.59 executables. Standalone EFLC, other builds and projectile/explosive silent aim are unsupported. The latest additions are included in GTA IV 2026.10.10.9 with Scooby Loader 4.82. Live gameplay acceptance remains pending. Bullet impacts, hitmarkers, named pickups, fire/explosive ammo, vehicle/ped guns, vehicle color picking, flying vehicles and shot/crosshair teleport are not included as completed features.

items.label: Magic bullet through-target distance

items.desc: Give the advanced eight-weapon set after its models have loaded, with configurable ammunition.

items.label: Loadout 2 — standard
items.desc: Give the standard eight-weapon set. Loading cancels if the player or campaign changes or model loading times out.

items.label: Loadout ammunition
items.desc: Choose ammunition per weapon in the Loadouts group; each weapon remains limited by its game ammo capacity.

items.label: Never flip
items.desc: Recover a tipped vehicle near loaded ground. Leaves upright vehicles and airborne stunts alone.

items.label: FOV fill and gradient
items.desc: Independent Lock On and Silent Aim circles with fill, opacity, two fill colors, vertical/horizontal gradients, line thickness and outlines.

items.label: Weapon and ammo label styling
items.desc: Separate weapon and ammunition labels with independent colors, gradients, outlines, text sizes, positions and offsets.

items.label: Bullet tracers
items.desc: Display local shot segments in Visuals / World with a configurable fade duration. These are shot paths, not confirmed impact markers.

items.label: Tracer duration
items.desc: Keep shot tracers visible for 0.1 to 5 seconds.
